svg.title: CutLink Lamb Cuts
svg.desc: Illustrative lamb cut selector. Forequarter is a commercial composite shown schematically in the front region; tenderloin is internal. Visible colour paths are the click targets. The website must consume selection events.

g.title: Shoulder
g.desc: Includes Shoulder, Square-Cut Shoulder, Boneless Shoulder, Rolled & Netted Shoulder.

g.data-subcuts: Rack,Frenched Rack,Rack Cap On,Rack Cap Off
g.title: Rack / Rib
g.desc: Includes Rack, Frenched Rack, Rack Cap On, Rack Cap Off.

g.title: Loin
g.desc: Includes Loin, Short Loin, Long Loin, Backstrap, Eye of Loin.

g.data-subcuts: Leg Chump On,Leg Chump Off,Boneless Leg,Topside,Silverside,Knuckle
g.title: Leg
g.desc: Includes Leg Chump On, Leg Chump Off, Boneless Leg, Topside, Silverside, Knuckle.

g.title: Trim / Manufacturing
g.desc: Includes Trim, Trunk Meat, Diced Lamb, Mince.

g.title: Offal / Other
g.desc: Includes Liver / Fry, Kidney, Heart, Tongue, Tail, Tripe, Bones.
